Export a table or query result to a Parquet dataset (chunked, low RAM)

Source: R/access_export.R
export_table_parquet.Rd

Reads chunk_size rows at a time and writes one .parquet file per chunk into output_dir. The result is a multi-file Arrow dataset that can be opened later with arrow::open_dataset(output_dir) - no size limit.

Usage

export_table_parquet(
  src_name = NULL,
  table = NULL,
  output_dir,
  schema = "raw",
  query = NULL,
  chunk_size = 1e+05,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  con = NULL
)

Arguments

src_name

Source name (e.g. "mimic_iv_demo"). Ignored when query is supplied directly.

table

Table name to export. Ignored when query is supplied.

output_dir

Directory to write .parquet files into. Created if it does not exist.

schema

"raw", "concepts", "derived", "harmonized", or a literal schema string. Legacy aliases "ts", "flat", and "dur" resolve to "harmonized". Ignored when query is supplied.

query

Optional: raw SQL string. Overrides src_name/table/schema.

chunk_size

Rows per chunk. Default 100 000. Tune to your RAM.

overwrite

If TRUE, delete output_dir contents first. Default FALSE.

verbose

Print chunk progress. Default TRUE.

con

Optional explicit DBI connection.

Value

Invisibly returns the total number of rows written.

Details

When output_dir ends in .parquet (single-file mode), the chunk files are merged into that one file with DuckDB (COPY ... FROM read_parquet(...)), not by collecting them into an R data frame - peak memory stays bounded by chunk_size throughout, including this final combine step, regardless of table size.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ehr_connect("rendehr", creds)

# Export a full table
export_table_parquet("mimic_iv_demo", "chartevents",
                     output_dir = "exports/chartevents_parquet")

# Export a custom query
export_table_parquet(
  query      = "SELECT * FROM mimic_iv_demo_coh.chartevents WHERE itemid = 220045",
  output_dir = "exports/hr_parquet"
)

# Read back without loading into RAM
arrow::open_dataset("exports/chartevents_parquet") |>
  dplyr::filter(value > 100) |>
  dplyr::collect()
} # }
